messages:
Ana (CS): Heads-up — HelioForge goes live in APAC tomorrow at 08:00 SGT. They requested: 1) allowlist for their edge proxies (3 addresses), 2) temporary QPS bump for a 4h launch window, 3) pinning to ap-southeast-1. They also called out renewal as at-risk if the launch has issues. Can NetOps + SRE handle config + monitoring?
Luca (Solutions): +1. I can run preflight tests and share a quick runbook. Do we have the exact IPs and the account id?
Devon (NetOps): I can add the allowlist and the QPS override. Need `account_id`, exact IPs (CIDR vs single hosts), and the UTC window start/end. Also, should we autorevoke the bump?
Ana (CS): Account: `helioforge-prod-001`. IPs: `203.0.113.45`, `203.0.113.46`, `2001:db8::8a2e:370:7334`. Launch window: 2026-03-24T00:00:00Z -> 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z. QPS: from 300 -> 1200 for that window. Please set autorevoke at +2 hours post-window (so total ttl 6h) and add region pin to `ap-southeast-1`. Product PM will be on call for 1 hour after start.
Devon (NetOps): Copy. I'll open CFG ticket and schedule change. Autorevoke sounds good. Will implement as `ipset` entries + rate override on the account route.
Devon (NetOps): (creates ticket) deploy-bot created CFG-4242 for `helioforge-prod-001` with allowlist + rate override + region pin. ETA for change: ~15m.
deploy-bot: Scheduled config change CFG-4242 — rollout plan: canary -> gradual 10% steps -> full. No infra downtime expected.
Sam (SRE): I'll add synthetic checks for token latency + error-rate. If p50 latency > 1200ms or 5xx rate > 1% we rollback the override and ping on-call. Also adding a short dashboard tile for the account.
Luca (Solutions): Pushed a canary test to `ap-southeast-1` with sample payloads. Quick validation curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":16}'` — expecting 200 and <300ms for canary.
Ana (CS): PM says they may ask for a temporary credit if we see throttling during the launch — flagging AM to prep renewal playbook. @Maria (AM) can you join post-launch?
Maria (AM): On it, I'll be on the post-launch sync and will draft a renewal contingency note.
Devon (NetOps): Change applied to canary (10%) — allowlist entries added: `203.0.113.45`, `203.0.113.46`, `2001:db8::8a2e:370:7334`. Rate override active on canary. Autorevoke scheduled at 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z.
Sam (SRE): Canary looks clean: 200s, p50 180ms, no spike in 5xx. Moving to 50% now.
Devon (NetOps): 50% -> 100% rollout completed. CFG-4242 closed. Logs snippet: ```
ALLOWLIST ADD helioforge-prod-001 203.0.113.45
ALLOWLIST ADD helioforge-prod-001 203.0.113.46
ALLOWLIST ADD helioforge-prod-001 2001:db8::8a2e:370:7334
RATE_OVERRIDE SET helioforge-prod-001 1200 QPS window 2026-03-24T00:00Z/2026-03-24T04:00Z AUTOREVOKE 2026-03-24T06:00Z
```
Ana (CS): Amazing, thanks everyone — leaving note in the account timeline and sending the PM the short runbook. :tada: If the PM reports any anomalies we escalate to on-call.
Luca (Solutions): I'll upload the runbook + post-launch checklist to the customer repo and @Ana will link it to the account.
Maria (AM): Follow-up: I'll propose a brief renewal incentive (1-month reduced committed capacity) if they hit any major launch problems. Will discuss with finance.
Ana (CS): Resolving this thread — successful rollout. Closing action: add post-launch survey to capture HelioForge feedback on onboarding experience.
